propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock assertions in tests cause CI flake under runner contention; a regex-based detector with 0 false positives identified 13 affected sites across 15 scanned, catching 11 unescaped instances.

Two test sites require migration from wall-clock bounds to counting proxies: test_config_perf.py:201 must spy config._ordered_layers miss-path; test_enrich_drain.py:261 must count pending_enrichment calls and assert zero drain invocations.

The detector must recognize two escape idioms (hang-guard comment marker with reason, and @pytest.mark.skipif(CI) guard on test functions) and exclude lower-bound assertions and non-timing code; bare @pytest.mark.benchmark without skipif does not escape.

Detector is deployed as a code-review DET blocking criterion in CI gating (_build-and-test.yml wall-clock-assert gate) with a teaching message naming both escapes and the counting-proxy migration strategy.
